simulator.note: Boots as the M3329 family (chips/m3329.py, chip ID 0x3101) from its 2 MB parallel NOR flash at 0xAFC00000: the 1.1.2 bootloader (STO_FLASH_0, "APP  init ok") unpacks maincode(AV) into SDRAM and starts it ("APP  init ok", "main emu init", "TPSKeyDB Initing... 0", "max_key_db_count = 442").  Because the JTAG dump's userdb(64+64) was captured in standby, PAN_COMMON_0 multiplexes its 74HC164 4-digit panel on GPIO 16..21 through " ON " -> "OFF " -> "----" -> "1737"; pressing POWER (NEC 0x807F00FF from its 76-entry 8-byte {nec32, vkey} remote table) writes the active power state to parallel NOR, pulses VPO reset (0xB8000060 bit 3) and soft-reboots to channel "OOO1", where OSD_M3327_0 renders its 720x576 8 bpp CLUT "Информация - Нет сигнала!" dialog and responds to MENU and DOWN.

desc: 2 MB Macronix MX29LV160B parallel-NOR JTAG flash dump (maincode dated 2008-03-19, preloaded with 4W/5E satellite channel list) from an Opticum 4000A / Globo 7010A DVB-S satellite receiver.

Captured while the receiver's userdb(64+64) power state was standby (clock 17:37); waking via IR POWER updates parallel NOR flash, soft-reboots into channel 0001, and renders the full 8 bpp CLUT Russian OSD and illustrated Main Menu.
